verdicts.reason: A keeps the stained-glass window clear of the edges with even top and bottom margins and keeps the original's three-column structure. But it shrank everything: the date and address text is tiny and hard to read, and the three groups float far apart with large empty gutters. B has a larger, more readable headline and details, but the window runs almost edge to edge, jammed against the top and bottom of the canvas so it looks cropped. That breaks the original's breathing room and makes the centre feel cramped next to wide empty sides.
